The first three are strictly negative on (0,s*], while S_5=0 precisely at s*=log(4/3)/log(3/2) and positive above. The character multiplicities 9+9+16+25=59 prove rank 34 at equality; Schoenberg gives PSD for all t and Euclidean Gaussian strict PD for distinct points; a positive centered mode yields failure for sufficiently small t beyond cutoff. Explicit all-s inequalities hold separately; finite spectra corroborate, do not prove it.
